source_provenance.semantic_scholar_resolution: api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/search, 2026-08-29, unauthenticated shared pool. Two passes + one time-boxed retry: 6/30 queries returned valid data (comp_mechanisms, concept_ablation, cot_faithful, extremalmask, gnninterpreter, pcbm); the other 24 were throttled with HTTP 429 on every attempt. All 6 valid responses corroborate the arXiv export-API resolution: 5 give the identical externalIds.ArXiv as top hit (2402.11655, 2303.13516, 2307.13702, 2305.18840, 2205.15480) and gnninterpreter returns the same id 2209.07924 at hit #2 beneath the [Re] report. Zero conflicts. Raw JSON per query in raw/s2_resolution/.
